DelaySampleProvider

Inserts up to N milliseconds of delay between source and output. Use it to align mirror targets that run on different transports - a Bluetooth speaker arrives ~150-300 ms later than a wired DAC, so delaying the wired side by the same amount keeps the room in phase.
